text: Join San Ysidro teachers and parents in voting to re-elect Martín Arias to the San Ysidro School Board!

“Martín Arias has shown he understands what our classrooms and our teachers need. That is why San Ysidro’s educators are proud to endorse him for re-election.” — Katina De Leon, President, San Ysidro Education Association
As your School Board Trustee, Martín has helped deliver results: balanced our district budget and restored reserves to 5%, strengthened school safety, and invested in modernizing our campuses.

Under this Board’s leadership, San Ysidro schools earned a California Golden Bell Award for English language development and a 2025 Innovation in Education Award for our Special Education STEAM Program.

The son of working-class immigrants, a father, and a San Diego State University graduate, Martín knows the sacrifices parents make to give their children a better future. Proud to advocate for families in both English and Spanish, Martín fights to ensure every parent has a voice, every teacher has the support to succeed, and every child has access to an excellent education.
Join our teachers, parents, and community in voting to re-elect Martín Arias.
“I would be honored to earn your vote!” – Martín Arias, Cell: 619-483-1122 Learn More at www.votemartinarias.com

text: As a grandparent, retired classified employee, former employee union president, and current San Ysidro School District Board President I offer a proven history of student focused, collaborative leadership. Throughout my career, I have worked in partnership with parents, teachers, classified educators, and community members to support student success.

I believe every student deserves the opportunity to succeed through strong literacy and mathematics instruction, STEM and arts education, multilingual programs, student wellness, safe schools, and expanded enrichment opportunities. I lead with integrity, transparency, and strong teamwork with families and community organizations because I know we achieve more when we work together.

During my tenure as a trustee, our District has earned two California School Boards Association Golden Bell Awards for community partnerships and English language programs, and our community has approved five general obligation bonds to modernize our schools.
I have proudly supported increased academic achievement, expanded educational programs strengthened family engagement, and efforts that earned state and national recognition for our district.

I remain committed to student achievement, supporting our teachers and school employees, practicing responsible governance and fiscal stewardship, strengthening family engagement, and providing collaborative leadership while ensuring every student has the opportunity to achieve their hopes and pursue their dreams.

text: As a proud San Ysidro resident, education advocate, and parent volunteer for more than 20 years, I’m honored to ask for your vote for the San Ysidro School District Board. My commitment has always been to our students, families, and schools because I believe every child deserves the opportunity to succeed, regardless of their ZIP code.

For over two decades, I”ve worked alongside parents, teachers, and community leaders to support schools and advocate for educational opportunities that help students thrive. These experiences have given me a deep understanding of the needs of our community and the importance of strong, accountable leadership.

If elected, I will be a dedicated voice for equity, transparency, and student success. I will work tirelessly to secure the resources and funding our schools deserve so that San Ysidro students have the same educational opportunities, programs, and support available in other school districts throughout San Diego County. Every child deserves access to quality teachers, safe learning environments, and programs that prepare them for college and life.

Together, we can build stronger schools, strengthen partnerships with families, and ensure students have tools to reach full potential. I respectfully ask for your trust, your support, and your vote to create brighter future.

text:
My name is Lidya Morales, as a San Ysidro resident for more than 25 years and proud parent, I understand the challenges our schools face, from a parent perspective, my interaction with parents, educators, school principals and district board members I have seen how dedicated educators can change student’s lives but also seen how bureaucracy can slow student progress. I will advocate and prioritize innovative learning by bringing creative, hands-on approaches into classrooms. I’ll prioritize more certified school educators and more student assistants for the students and professors.
I’ll advocate for safe and inclusive schools-Ensuring every student feels valued and protected, eradicate bullying.
I’ll prioritize excellence in education, also by extending and enhancing the after school program by bringing more attractive activities for students like art classes, craft classes and other activities while understanding that all working families need more help with their students that need to be using their time in a positive safe environment while their parents are absent.
More tools for parents to participate in students’ education journey. I’m running because I want to inspire change, together we can create schools with a safer environment that prepare our children for continuing education and for life.

text: I am Mike “Miguel” Ochoa, a father of four, grandfather of six, and longtime South Bay resident committed to restoring excellence, accountability, and public trust in the San Ysidro School District.

I earned a B.A. in Political Science from UCLA, with an emphasis in American Politics, and a Master of Advanced Studies in International Affairs from the UC San Diego School of Global Policy and Strategy. My education has prepared me to analyze budgets, develop sound public policy, and make responsible decisions that put students first.

Our district faces serious financial challenges, declining enrollment, and growing concerns about student safety. I believe we must restore fiscal responsibility, improve academic achievement, strengthen partnerships with parents and teachers, and ensure every dollar is spent wisely in the classroom.

One of my highest priorities is improving children’s safety by implementing modern security measures, including surveillance cameras where appropriate, to help protect students, staff, and school property.

I will provide transparent, accountable leadership that listens to our community, respects taxpayers, supports our educators, and always puts the needs of students first. Together, we can restore confidence in our schools and build a stronger future for every child in San Ysidro.

text: After attending countless school board meetings and watching the district almost be taken over by the state due to a possible insolvency, I decided enough is enough. It is time for SYSD to go back to the basics.

This all starts by making sure every hard-earned tax dollar is spent wisely on services that provide educational value for our students. The poor academic results our district has received show that our students need services such as tutoring, not after-school dance classes that no one uses. The voters were promised a replacement for Beyer Elementary, not a community center. I plan on using this property wisely. District employees struggle with the unaffordability, but we can fix this. I am looking into developing housing opportunities for employees and the community with land that the district currently owns. Looking outside of the box to address the issues that affect our educators and our district’s budget.

My goal is to listen to the community. As a candidate, I have established a survey on my website brandonforsysd.com to gather feedback from the community. My goal is to tackle the issues head-on once elected into office. I look forward to improving our district!

text:
I am a proud 27-year San Ysidro resident, parent special education advocate, and community leader.
My advocacy began when my daughters entered preschool in the San Ysidro School District. As a parent of children with disabilities, I realized I needed to learn my rights and my children’s rights to successfully navigate the educational system. I discovered that real advocacy means showing up, staying committed, and being present for our families.
This journey connected me with many other special education parents who saw the same injustices affecting our students. Together, we chose to get involved, educate ourselves, and fight for systemic change on behalf of all children.
I serve on the San Ysidro Community Planning Group, where I work to improve our neighborhoods. I served 2 years on the San Ysidro Middle School Site Council and have actively participated in district committees because I believe parent engagement and community involvement are essential to student success.
I will always put students first. Strong schools are built on meaningful parent engagement.I will also eliminate language barriers so every family can fully participate in their children’s education and in district decision making.
San Ysidro is leadership that listens and puts students first. Roxaneforsanysidro.com

text: As a retired Dual Language Educator, former California Teacher of the Year, and Rookie Board Member of the Year for San Diego and Imperial Counties, I bring nearly four decades of classroom experience and proven educational leadership. I understand what our students need to succeed, care deeply about their future, and ensure every decision puts students first to strengthen their educational journey.

During my first term on the Board of Education, we achieved remarkable success. We won two California School Boards Association Golden Bell Awards, restored fiscal stability despite declining enrollment to protect classroom programs, secured five school bonds to modernize our campuses, and celebrated our nationally recognized SciPhy Program, reflecting our commitment to innovation and academic excellence.

My priority has always been students. I am a fierce advocate for multilingual learners, students with special needs, and military-connected families. I believe student success is built through strong partnerships among families, employees, and the community.

Schools should be the safe, inspiring heart of our community. With your vote, I will continue providing experienced leadership, partnering with families, managing taxpayer dollars responsibly, supporting our dedicated staff, and empowering our students.
I respectfully ask for your vote.

text: For more than 30 years, I proudly served as the District’s Executive Secretary, working alongside numerous Board Members and superintendents. Through that experience, I gained firsthand knowledge of school governance, district finances, board policies, and the decisions that shape our schools. I am not a politician—I am a trusted public servant who understands that every decision should be guided by what is best for students and families.

As a lifelong San Ysidro resident, parent, and grandparent, I care deeply about our community and the future of our children. I believe every student deserves a high-quality education, every family deserves to be heard, and every decision should put students first.

As your School Board Trustee, I will lead with integrity, transparency, collaboration, and fiscal responsibility. I will support our wonderful families, our outstanding teachers, and our dedicated classified team. I will advocate for safe schools, protect classroom instruction, and ensure that taxpayer dollars are spent wisely.
I am ready to put my extensive experience, knowledge, and commitment to work for our students, families, and community. I respectfully ask for your vote.
